info.description: Unified Scoracle API serving sport data pages, derived products (narratives, transfer heat, Vibe, Sigil — precomputed by the Rust cognition layer), health checks, and operational endpoints.
info.title: Scoracle Data API

get.description: Returns API name, version, status, and available optimizations.

post.description: Creates a new anonymous user and returns an access + refresh token pair. First launch only; later launches use /auth/refresh.
Registers (or reactivates) the device's push token for the authenticated user. Requires a bearer token.
Revokes the given refresh token. Requires a bearer token.
Validates a refresh token, rotates it (the old one is revoked), and returns a new access + refresh pair. 401 if expired/revoked/unknown.

get.description: Returns serving readiness; 503 when the database is unreachable.
Returns in-memory cache statistics (active keys, expired keys).
Verifies Postgres connectivity.
The sport's autofill + search payload for frontend local hydration — the dedicated home for what /meta historically served.
Returns sport data freshness and counts.
Positionless rating board (z-score engine). entity_type=player (default) or team. Composite + Sigil in one payload.

parameters.description: Board: composite (default), sigil, or a sigil label (e.g. Sacks)
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: Season year (defaults to the latest rated season)
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Filter to a position (player boards only)
parameters.name: position

get.description: Sport-wide board of entities with the most breaking-news bulletins in the last 2 days.
Sport-wide board of the most-mentioned entities in the news corpus over the rolling window.
Sport-wide board of entities ranked by their latest Sigil crown score (1-100), the holistic Rating+Vibe synthesis. With the Sigil blurb + previous_score delta.
Sport-wide board of the hottest Gemma-vetted transfer rumors, ranked by heat (0-100).
Entities ranked by their recent trajectory slope (risers). metric=vibe (default) or rating.
Sport-wide board of entities ranked by latest vibe sentiment (1-100). With the Vibe felt-read blurb.
Returns sport data freshness and counts for a specific league.
Returns metadata and search payload for a specific league.
League-scoped variant of GetTeamResults — leagueId comes from the URL path. Identical payload.
League-scoped momentum payload. Mirrors GetTrendsPage with leagueId taken from the URL path.
Returns complete metadata and search payload for a sport.
Returns the team's list of finalized fixtures (status completed/seeded) for a season, framed from the team's perspective with opponent identity and W/L/D.
Players on the team's season roster with season Composite/Sigil (+ ranks + sigil label), ordered by the Composite+Sigil sum. Player names link to the player profile.
The entity's breaking-news bulletins (transfer, injury, coaching, contract, other) from the last 2 days.
The entity's identity for the page header: name, image, physicals, current team/club, position, tier.
Returns the entity's last-3 event averages and peer-cohort season averages so the frontend can derive recent direction relative to peers. Raw values only.
The entity's latest Gemma narratives (hottest first) ranked by per-narrative impact.
The entity's positionless magnitude score, divined defining strength, and the Gemma stat-identity blurb.
get.summary: Get the entity rating (magnitude + strength + identity blurb)

get.description: The entity's holistic Sigil synthesis — score (1-100) + blurb fusing Rating + Vibe + Momentum — plus a bounded history.
The entity's season Composite rating (breakdown, modes, fantasy, scoped ranks) + available seasons.
The entity's vetted transfer/trade rumors ranked by deterministic heat (team→players, player→clubs).
